title: Richland WA Photographer | It's A Keeper Photography
description: Lisa lives and photographs in Richland, WA — golden-hour sessions at Howard Amon Park, Badger Mountain, the river paths and the corners only locals know.

hero.heading: Your Richland, WA Photographer
hero.intro: Senior pictures, family sessions, newborns and branding photography in Richland — from a photographer who's been chasing this town's golden hour for twenty years.
hero.imageAlt: High school senior photographed beside the river in warm evening light in the Tri-Cities
hero.secondaryImageAlt: Warm golden-hour portrait among flowers in the Tri-Cities

sections.heading: I Don't Just Work in Richland — I Live Here
paragraphs: It's A Keeper Photography is based right here in Richland. This is where I raised my family, where my business grew from a mom with a point-and-shoot into twenty years of professional photography, and where I know — down to the week — when the light turns gold along the river.

That matters more than it sounds. When you book a Richland session with me, you're not getting a photographer guessing at locations from Google Maps. You're getting someone who knows which park empties out at dinnertime, where the trees hold their color longest in October, and exactly where the sun drops behind the ridge.
sections.imageAlt: Family embracing outdoors during a golden-hour portrait session in the Tri-Cities
sections.secondaryImageAlt: Lisa photographing a portrait session outdoors in the Tri-Cities

items.heading: Along the Columbia River
paragraphs: Howard Amon Park and the riverfront paths give us water, willows and that soft evening glow coming off the Columbia. Perfect for families with kids who need room to run.
items.imageAlt: Golden-hour portrait beside the river in the Tri-Cities

items.heading: Fields, hills and open sky
paragraphs: The open spaces around Badger Mountain and the edges of West Richland turn amber at golden hour — my favorite backdrop for seniors and couples who want that warm, wide-open feel.
items.imageAlt: Portrait in an open outdoor setting in the Tri-Cities

items.heading: A place that's already yours
paragraphs: Your backyard, grandma's orchard, the spot where he proposed. Some of my favorite Richland sessions have happened in places that already held a memory.
items.imageAlt: Couple sharing a quiet moment during an outdoor portrait session

items.heading: Do you have a studio in Richland?
paragraphs: My sessions happen outdoors in natural light — Richland's parks, river paths and open spaces are my studio.

items.heading: What's the best time of year for photos in Richland?
paragraphs: Every season has its light. October gives us autumn color along the river; summer evenings are warm and golden; spring brings blossoms. We'll match the season to your story.

items.heading: Do you travel outside Richland?
paragraphs: Yes — I photograph throughout the Tri-Cities, including Kennewick and Pasco, at no extra charge.
